items.title: XYL Q3 deep dive: portfolio reshaping and delayed utility spending drive guidance revision
items.summary: Water technology company Xylem (NYSE:XYL) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales falling 3% year on year to $2.20 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $8.95 billion at the midpoint came in 2.6% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.44 per share was 0.7% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Xylem (XYL) Stock Price Sinks After Q3 Results Miss Revenue Mark
items.summary: Xylem just reported Q3 2026 results and the stock took a hit. The shares closed at US$108.24 before the release and then dropped about 14% to US$92.86 as investors reacted in a hurry. The headline is not collapsing demand. It is a revenue miss tied to slower project conversion while profitability held up, with adjusted EBITDA margin sitting in the mid 20s and quarterly basic earnings per share at about US$1.25.
